Deployment `missing-env-1101-120000` in `triage-lab` crash-loops: the logs say `DATABASE_URL is not set`. The deployment expects the database credentials from Secret `orders-db-credentials`, which does not exist in the namespace.

Create the Secret with the database URL and restart the deployment:
```
kubectl create secret generic orders-db-credentials -n triage-lab --from-literal=DATABASE_URL=<url>
kubectl rollout restart deployment/missing-env-1101-120000 -n triage-lab
```
